name: Getting Ready to Sell: Essential Steps Before Listing Your Home

step.name: Step 1: Conduct a pre-listing assessment. Walk through your home with an objective eye, noting any repairs, updates, or decluttering needed to enhance its appeal and value. This helps you prioritize tasks.
step.text: Step 1: Conduct a pre-listing assessment. Walk through your home with an objective eye, noting any repairs, updates, or decluttering needed to enhance its appeal and value. This helps you prioritize tasks.

step.name: Step 2: Address minor repairs and maintenance. Fix leaky faucets, patch small holes, and ensure all light fixtures are working. These small details contribute to a well-maintained impression.
step.text: Step 2: Address minor repairs and maintenance. Fix leaky faucets, patch small holes, and ensure all light fixtures are working. These small details contribute to a well-maintained impression.

step.name: Step 3: Declutter and depersonalize. Remove excess personal items, clear countertops, and organize closets and cabinets. This creates a clean, spacious, and inviting environment for potential buyers.
step.text: Step 3: Declutter and depersonalize. Remove excess personal items, clear countertops, and organize closets and cabinets. This creates a clean, spacious, and inviting environment for potential buyers.

step.name: Step 4: Deep clean your home. Pay attention to often-overlooked areas like baseboards, windows, and grout. A sparkling clean home signals care and attention to detail.
step.text: Step 4: Deep clean your home. Pay attention to often-overlooked areas like baseboards, windows, and grout. A sparkling clean home signals care and attention to detail.

step.name: Step 5: Boost curb appeal. Mow the lawn, trim bushes, plant fresh flowers, and clean your entryway. First impressions are crucial, and a welcoming exterior draws buyers in.
step.text: Step 5: Boost curb appeal. Mow the lawn, trim bushes, plant fresh flowers, and clean your entryway. First impressions are crucial, and a welcoming exterior draws buyers in.

step.name: Step 6: Consult with a real estate specialist for a valuation. Have an expert assess your property's market value and discuss strategic pricing. This ensures your home is priced competitively from day one.
step.text: Step 6: Consult with a real estate specialist for a valuation. Have an expert assess your property's market value and discuss strategic pricing. This ensures your home is priced competitively from day one.

step.name: Step 7: Prepare professional marketing materials. Work with your agent to arrange for high-quality photos, videos, and possibly aerial imagery. These visuals are critical for online listings and making your home shine.
